candidate.title: MES intraday 10/30 SMA crossover
candidate.one_line: Trade the first same-session 10-bar versus 30-bar simple moving average cross and exit before the cash close.

hypothesis.behavior: A fresh 10-bar/30-bar crossover within the US cash session may predict directional MES continuation before that session closes.
failure_theory: Frequent intraday whipsaws may erase gross crossover gains.
Waiting for 30 same-session bars may enter too late.
Fixed per-contract fees and adverse next-bar execution may erase an apparent edge.

setup: Reset both close-based simple moving averages at each complete NYSE regular session.
Skip missing or non-contiguous five-minute sessions and early closes; never compute a crossover across a futures roll or session gap.
long_entry: Take the first completed-bar cross of the 10-bar SMA above the 30-bar SMA after both and their prior values exist; enter at the next contiguous five-minute open.
short_entry: Take the first completed-bar cross of the 10-bar SMA below the 30-bar SMA after both and their prior values exist; enter at the next contiguous five-minute open.

exits.time_exit: Signal exit at 15:50 ET for a 15:55 ET next-bar-open fill; no position remains after the session.

special_assumptions.roll_gaps: same-session indicators and flat-at-close trades; no cross-session return counted

candidate_specific_checks: At least 20 completed trades, positive total and annualized return, Sharpe at least 0.5, and drawdown at most 35% after baseline costs.
Run the declared chronological out-of-sample, walk-forward, higher-cost, regime, and simulation gates only if earlier gates pass.
Keep the protected test closed; no parameter tuning or second average pair after seeing results.

exclusions: No crossover across session or futures roll gaps.
No optimization, parameter sweep, alternate average pair, stop, target, or hidden filter in this Candidate.
No paper/live trading or automatic promotion.
